## 📌 Adding a New Project

For the auto-generator to pick up a project correctly, its `README.md` must start like this:

```markdown
# Project Name

> One-line description of what this project does.

Status: 🚧 In Progress
```

**Status options:** `✅ Done` · `🚧 In Progress` · `🧪 Testing` · `⏸️ Paused`
